name: Spectrum
_comment: Insert effect: LSP Spectrum Analyzer (stereo) shown as 31 third-octave bars; audio passes through. vst.json/params.json/presets.json/layout.conf feed mpc-vst-plugins' tools/gen_vst.py for params.h + the skin, skin_post.py adds the bars. The plugin is spectrum_vst.cpp + fxshell.h (float audio), built by this port's own build.sh. params.json: append only (params.lock).
